item.text:
No additional defect was confirmed in this pass. The latest protocol-level LFU reproduction remains decisive: after cache resynchronization, two replicas reported the same decided index but stored different entry values (`"C"` versus `"A"`).

The audit remains at 27 confirmed findings. Highest-impact issues are:

- LFU cache resynchronization causing replica value divergence,
- delta-snapshot synchronization corrupting decided state,
- `AcceptSync` reducing a follower’s decided index,
- persistent failed-write leakage and destructive suffix replacement,
- timeout retry duplication,
- LRU bincode deserialization failure.

The full report and all reproduction artifacts remain available at [report.md](/home/nitro/Desktop/consensus-assurance/baseline/runs/2026-10-17_22-19-35-omnipaxos-baseline/work/report.md).
